headline: Live Oak Bancshares Beats Third-Quarter Sales Expectations
summary: Live Oak Bancshares reported third-quarter 2026 financial results that exceeded analyst sales expectations.
why: Live Oak Bancshares is a national digital lender and one of the largest originators of government-guaranteed small business loans in the US.

impacts.name: Live Oak Bancshares
impacts.why: Sales beating consensus forecasts reflects resilient small business borrowing activity.
